Fleet positions interpolated between GPS pings (~4–15min interval); Photon's wind/speed/heel are its own 1Hz onboard log. Hover any boat on the map for its name; click or drag on any chart to jump the whole replay (map + compass + other charts) to that moment — the vertical line marks the current time on every chart.
